label: rare weak firing at end of input / <DEL> in long sequences starting with o or 3
explanation: Very sparse, weak feature (0.025% of steps, max 0.25). Its activations sit around the end of the original input: 53% of mass is on the <DEL> step, 38% on the last few original tokens, and 9% on the first copy step (recall_idx 1). It never fires at t<3 or after recall_idx 1. Rates rise with L (L=9 holds about half the mass) and with first_tok o or 3 (lift about 10x, 70% of mass). The strongest examples often have f or z among the first original tokens. Even so, firing is rare under every condition tried: only about 0.2% of <DEL> steps fire, and the best predicates reach about 8% precision (F1 < 0.1). No coherent predicate captures it. Magnitude is highest at <DEL> and next-highest on the first copy step in o/3-initial sequences.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=o (+5.59), orig0=3 (+5.24), orig1=f (+3.23), orig0=t (+3.20), orig2=f (+3.03), orig1=z (+2.96). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-4.28), phase=2 (-3.81), orig1=2 (-2.05), orig2=w (-2.05).
